name: rk3576-sensevoice
description: Rockchip RK3576: SenseVoice offline ASR on the NPU (RKNN fp16, zh/en/ja/ko/yue) for Clip transcription. One NPU worker: the backend reports supports_parallel=False, and a second worker needs about 1 GB more RAM than an 8 GB RK3576 has free next to other services.
